text:
Ava: Quick sync — I put together a single draft that covers launch posts, the webinar gating flow, and inbound routing for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Need quick decisions by EOD so we can push variants to Webflow. Draft: https://docs.google.com/launch-draft (please comment inline).

Sam: Scanning now. High-level: hero needs a cleaner value claim. Suggest we call out 'predictable latency and cost' in one line, then a short subline about three deployment modes.

Priya: For the webinar gating, let’s make the CTA: "Register + Get the Benchmark PDF" so registrants are also routed into the benchmark nurture. Also need explicit lead routing: enterprise (> $X ARR) -> AE queue, pilot interest -> SE nurture, self-serve -> product onboarding flow.

Diego: Can we set up two hero variants to test? Variant A focuses on "latency SLAs" and Variant B on "cost per token savings". My bet is latency wins for mid-market/enterprise traffic.

Kai: For the Dedicated page we should include a short throughput stat and a 1-line customer quote about stability under load. Also add a small explainer about private deployments (VPC/on-prem) — some folks scan for that first.

OpsBot: Document updated with Sam's hero suggestions and a new section 'Routing matrix (v1)'. View: https://docs.google.com/launch-draft#updates (auto-notify)

Ava: Nice. I will: 1) update hero copy and create two Webflow variants, 2) add the Dedicated stat/Kai quote placeholder, 3) wire the webinar gating CTA. @Priya can you own the routing table and the nurture sequences?

Priya: Yes — I’ll produce the routing table by tomorrow morning. For gated benchmark PDF, I’ll loop in Legal for IP checks. Also adding utm params: utm_campaign=launch_q2_2026.

Sam: I’ll create two micro-hero options, each <= 12 words, and a 15-word subline. Posting options in the doc in 1 hour.

Diego: :thumbsup: Also recommend we tag traffic from paid launch posts to an experiment in GA4 so we can see conversion lift between hero variants.

Kai: I’ll add the GA4 event and make sure Dedicated CTA triggers the enterprise routing event. Quick note: for Private customers we should surface KMS/HSM and audit logs in a second fold so security teams see it early.

Ava: Timeline sync — edits today, publish Webflow variants tomorrow AM, webinar gating + registration page live Thu EOD. Final checklist for handoff: 1) two hero variants in Webflow, 2) routing table + nurture owners, 3) benchmark PDF gated and legal-approved, 4) tracking params and GA4 events implemented.

Priya: I’ll include a simple routing snippet in the doc:
```
if lead.size == "enterprise": route -> AE_queue
elif lead.intent == "pilot": route -> SE_nurture
else: route -> self-serve_onboard
```

Sam: Will keep copy tight. I’ll also add an optional headline that calls out "Unified inference across Hosted, Dedicated, Private" as a scan-friendly string.

OpsBot: Exported current draft to PDF for review: https://files.redwood/launch-draft-v1.pdf (automated)

Ava: Thanks all — I’ll post the Webflow links here once variants are up. If anyone sees major pushback on the hero wording, flag it now. Otherwise I’ll proceed with latency-first hero as Variant A and cost-first as Variant B.

Diego: Proceed. I’ll prepare the paid post copy variations next.

Priya: On it. I’ll also map inbound emails produced by the webinar to the AE queue and add a Slack alert for new enterprise leads.

Sam: Done with draft hero snippets — uploaded to the doc. Short and punchy.

Ava: Great — closing this thread for now. I’ll reopen if blockers come up. :rocket:
